hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,subprocess,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); last=d.get("last_assistant_message") or ""; markers=("Forgetful memory curation:", "No durable memory to save.", "Saved to memory:"); prompt="Run $memory-curate for this completed turn. Files changed in the repo, so check whether any durable decisions, project knowledge, preferences, or implementation patterns should be saved. Only persist durable reusable knowledge with importance >= 7. Query Forgetful for duplicates before writing. Prefer updating, linking, or marking obsolete over duplicate creation. If nothing qualifies, reply exactly: Forgetful memory curation: No durable memory to save."; out=None; out={"continue": False, "stopReason": "Forgetful memory curation already ran for this stop"} if d.get("stop_hook_active") else out; out={"continue": False, "stopReason": "Forgetful memory curation already handled"} if out is None and any(m in last for m in markers) else out; status=None if out is not None else subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=2); out={"continue": False, "stopReason": "No git working tree changes detected for Forgetful memory curation"} if out is None and (status.returncode != 0 or not status.stdout.strip()) else out; out={"decision": "block", "reason": prompt} if out is None else out; print(json.dumps(out))'
